title: Transform Point/Segment
content: **List of Contents** Transform Point/Segment Rotating Segment Scaling Segment Scaling Segment with Pivot Point Activated Moving Point/Segment **Transform Point/Segment** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TLnxSo3-DQw \- Move, rotate and scale point and segment. \- Navigate to the 2D toolbar and hold down the **Edit Pattern** tool as the**Transform Point/Segment** tool will appear below. **Rotating Segment** * **Rotating Segment** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TR24kj6RBoI \- Select the **Transform Point/Segment** tool from the 2D toolbar. \- Click on the segment to be rotated. \- The selected segment will be highlighted in yellow as a marquee box appears. \- Hover the mouse over the scale point on top of the marquee box. The mouse cursor will appear as a rotating wheel. \- Click and drag the scale point towards the desired direction. \- The segment will rotate around its center. * **Rotating Segment with Pivot Point Activated** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=btcknMZxBjk \- Select the **Transform Point/Segment** tool from the 2D toolbar. \- Click on the segment to be rotated. \- The selected segment will be highlighted in yellow as a marquee box appears. \- Double click on the Pivot Point located at the center of the marquee box. \- The Pivot Point will be activated as it is highlighted in orange. \- Click and drag the activated Pivot Point to where the selected segment’s rotation should be centered on. \- Hover over the scale point on top of the marquee box. The mouse cursor will appear as a rotating wheel. \- Click and drag the scale point towards the desired direction. \- The selected segment will rotate accordingly centering on the Pivot Point. **Scaling Segment** * **Scaling Segment Manually ** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9UayceTAYTA \- Select the **Transform Point/Segment** tool from the 2D toolbar. \- Click on the segment to be scaled. \- The selected segment will be highlighted in yellow as a marquee box appears. \- Click one of the scale points and drag towards the selected segment to be scaled. * **Scaling Segment with specific value ** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-gjn1jugDrc \- Select the **Transform Point/Segment** tool from the 2D toolbar. \- Click on the segment to be scaled. \- The selected segment will be highlighted in yellow as a marquee box appears. \- Click one of the scale points and drag towards the selected segment to be scaled. \- As holding down the scale point, right click on the mouse. The Transform pop-up window will appear. \- Type in desired PERCENTAGE and DIMENSION, and then hit OK. \- The selected segment will be scaled accordingly. **Scaling Segment with Pivot Point Activated** * **Scaling Segment Manually ** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NT8svX4rCSs \- Select the **Transform Point/Segment** tool from the 2D toolbar. \- Click on the segment to be scaled. \- The selected segment will be highlighted as a marquee box appears. \- Double click on the Pivot Point located at the center of the marquee box. \- The Pivot Point will be activated as it is highlighted in orange. \- Click and drag the activated Pivot Point to where it will be the center of the transformation. \- Click one of the scale points and drag towards the segment to be scaled. \- The selected segment will be lengthened or shortened centering on the Pivot Point. * **Scaling Segment with specific value ** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SGENfzIV6JY \- Select the **Transform Point/Segment** tool from the 2D toolbar. \- Click on the segment to be scaled. \- The selected segment will be highlighted as a marquee box appears. \- Double click on the Pivot Point located at the center of the marquee box. \- The Pivot Point will be activated as it is highlighted in orange. \- Click and drag the activated Pivot Point to where it will be the center of the transformation. \- Click one of the scale points and drag towards the segment to be scaled. \- As holding down the scale point, right click on the mouse. The Transformation pop-up window will appear. \- Type in desired PERCENTAGE and DIMENSION, then hit OK. \- The selected segment will be lengthened or shortened centering on the Pivot Point. **Moving Point/Segment** * **Moving Point/Segment Manually ** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oK-Gt-doXDg \- Select the **Transform Point/Segment** tool from the 2D toolbar. \- Click and drag the point/segment to be moved. \- Move the point/segment to desired place in the 2D Window and release the mouse to complete the movement. * **Moving Point/Segment with specific value ** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KhmD5t67ZdI \- Select the **Transform Point/Segment** tool from the 2D toolbar. \- Click and drag the point/segment to be moved. \- As holding down the point/segment, right click on the mouse. The Moving Distance pop-up window will appear. \- Type in desired value and hit OK. \- The point/segment will be moved accordingly. Go back to the List of Contents
content_description: This web page serves as a comprehensive guide to transforming points and segments in a 2D environment, featuring detailed instructions and instructional videos on moving, rotating, and scaling elements with precision.

title: How can I delete my account?
content: Understand how to delete account on CLO. 1. Delete account after unsubscribing current license/plan 2. Delete account immediately ## ## **Details** #### #### **1) Delete Account after unsubscribing current licenses** 1\. Visit “[My Account](https://www.clo3d.com/en/signin)” page from **CLO** to start the account deletion process. ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/47212379769625) ![clo my account.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/47212392027417) 2\. Click "Delete My Account" button at the bottom of "Account" tab. ![delete account.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/49470792099609) 3\. Click "Delete" button to further proceed. ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/49470792105113) _💡**Note:** If account is using Enterprise license on CLO / Marvelous Designer or, account is seller_ _on CONNECT and there is an unsettled amount remaining, you won't be able to delete_ _the account directly. Please click**"Contact US"** button for further assistance._ ![mceclip3.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/49470852432409) 4\. Current license/plan will be displayed and must be canceled before account deletion. * All **CLO** and **MD** licenses, as well as any **CLO-SET paid plans** , must be unsubscribed in the area marked as **①**. * **You must leave any CLO-SET groups** in the area marked as **②**. _**💡 Note:** After canceling your licenses and plans, you will still be able to use the service until their expiration date. The “Continue” button will become active **only after the end date.**_ ![mceclip6.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/49470852433945) #### **2) Delete Account immediately** 1. To immediately delete the account without waiting for the license/plan end date, click the “Delete My Account” button in the area marked as ③ _💡**Note:** Please note that any active paid plans and associated data will be immediately terminated and deleted upon proceeding. Make sure to review carefully before continuing._ ![mceclip7.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/49470852437657) 2\. Account will be deleted immediately after email verification and a short survey are completed. ![mceclip8.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/49470852442649) * * * **Important Notes on Account Deletion** 1) Once deleted, the account cannot be recovered, and sign-in will no longer be possible on both the website and software. 2) After deletion, content and posts previously created will display the user name as follows: * If the email address is shown: **“Deleted Account”** will be displayed instead. * If the account name is shown: it will remain as **{account name}** , as in the case of CLO-SET.
content_description: This web page provides step-by-step instructions on how to delete your CLO account, including necessary actions for unsubscribing from licenses and options for immediate deletion.

title: Express Glitter (ver5.0.0)
content: **Objective** Express various glitter with different color. **Location** Object Browser ▶ Property Editor (Select Fabric) ▶ Material ▶ Type ▶ **Glitter (Render Only)** ** Operation** 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: Object Browser ▶ Property Editor (Select Fabric) ▶ Material ▶ Type **▶ Glitter (Render Only) ** ※Note: To preview the glitter, please navigate to the Main Menu ▶ Render ▶ Render ▶ [Interactive Render](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115014784747-Run-V-Ray-Render). 2. Refer to the below table and express the desired glitter by modifying the properties. **Option** | **Description** ---|--- **Glitter Parameters** | Color | Set glitter color. Number | Set the number of the glitter particles. Higher the value is, more the glitter particles are, and vice-versa. ![size.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/360016896653/size.png) Saturation Variation | Randomize each glitter particle's color. When the value is 0, there's no variation to the color, showing the color set by the user. On the other hand, more color appear when the value is 1. ※Note: When one of the R, G, B values of the color is dominant, saturation variation occurs within the corresponding color value. In the above case, you may not see various color. To express various color, please set R, G, B values similarly. ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/360016142614/mceclip0.png)
content_description: This web page provides a comprehensive guide to customizing and rendering glitter effects in your design projects, allowing you to express a variety of colors and particle densities.

title: Washing File (JEAN) of Jeanologia Import/ Export
content: **List of Contents** **Import JEAN File** **Export JEAN File** **Objective** Import a washing file(JEAN) of eDesigner, which is an application of [Jeanologia](https://www.jeanologia.com/) offering laser washing solution, and apply it on a garment as a graphic. When exporting a tech pack(JSON), the applied and edited washing can be exported as JEAN file again. **📝Note:** To import or export JEAN file, eDesigner Plugin must be installed on PC. **Location ** **Import JEAN File** 3D/2D Toolbar ▶ [Graphic (3D/2D Pattern) tool](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/ko/articles/115000483967-%EA%B7%B8%EB%9E%98%ED%94%BD-%EC%83%9D%EC%84%B1) **Export JEAN File** File ▶ Export ▶ **Jean (JEAN)** **Operation ** **Import JEAN File** 1. Click the tool/menu indicated in Location. → **Open File** window appears. ** ** 2. Click JEAN file. → **eDesigner Login** window appears. 3. Enter the ID and PW of eDesigner then click **Login** button. → The washing image is previewed in the**Import JEAN File** window. 4. Refer to the table below and import JEAN file by clicking the desired option. **Option** | **Description** ---|--- **Apply All** | Automatically identifies the face of the pattern and all washing images of JEAN file are applied. This functions normally by the type of pants, edit the JEAN file exported from CLO in eDesigner, then import it back to apply to the same garment. When a garment and JEAN file are not corresponding, you can miss the washing file or position and scale may not be matching. Import the missing image individually. **OK (Apply a single image)** | Adds a single washing image that appeared in the **Import JEAN file** window. To apply a washing to the double layers like a back pocket of pants, refer to the contents below. 1) Copy the back pattern piece that applied a washing image. 2) Cut the Internal Shape/ Baseline of the pocket in the back pattern piece. 3) Sew the cut pocket pattern piece onto the back pattern again. 4) Delete the original pocket and the remaining pattern pieces. **※Note:** Drag and drop a JEAN file from Library or OS Dialogue to 3D/2D window. ** Export JEAN File** 1. Click the tool/ menu indicated in Location. → Export File window appears. 2. Designate the file saving path and name the file, then click **OK**. **※Note:** * Due to eDesigner supports only PNG format, you must export a graphic in PNG. * You can only export a graphic by following the steps: [Graphic Properties ▶ Classification ▶ Wash (Jeanologia)](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/ko/articles/360049969394-%EA%B7%B8%EB%9E%98%ED%94%BD-%EC%86%8D%EC%84%B1) * Ensure that you do not classify the file as Wash (Jeanologia) to prevent exporting the duplicated file when the same washing is applied to the double layer like the back pocket sewn into the back pattern. * You can set the washing file(JEAN) type to Wash or Breakage. (ver 6.1) [Go back to the List of Contents](-#Click)
content_description: This web page provides guidance on importing and exporting JEAN files for applying and editing washing graphics in eDesigner, a laser washing solution by Jeanologia.

title: Advanced Pinching
content: **New in CLO 2025.0 ** **Apply the Soft Selection options to the Pinching function during simulation.** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Nq_oZNdlqF0?si=rhthmAWJb8SatCHi 1. Click the ![Simulation Normal On.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/44158677325209)**Simulate** tool in the 3D toolbar. 2. Click and hold the **![3D Select On.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/44158677334041)****Select/Move** tool for more than 2 seconds, then click the **![Advanced Pinching On.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/44158685113497)Advanced Pinching** tool. 3. Set the options in Advanced Pinch Settings window. **Option** | **Description** ---|--- **Range** | The shape graph reflects the selected Falloff(Shape/Distance/Power) and cannot be manipulated directly. **Falloff Shape** | Select the Falloff Shape: Bump or Linear ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/44157625001753) **Falloff Distance** | Set the distance of the selection range to the radius: Min: 1, Max: 500 ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/46860016841497) **Falloff Power** | A value that sets the strength of falloff. (Min:-2.0, Max:+2.0) ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/44157625003673) **Options** | **Distance Measure** | How the distance from the picking point is measured. Surface | When multiple layers of patterns are together, only one independent layer will be selected. Straight | Select all patterns within a certain distance from the picking point regardless of the layer selected. **Distance Indicator** | Indicates the Falloff Distance/Power values using 2 concentric circles around the pinch icon. When turned off the circles will disappear. ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/44157615799705) **Limit to Selected Patterns** | When the Distance Measure is set to **Straight** , the selection range is applied only to the initially selected pattern. ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/44157625008025) **Display Weights** | Display a contrasting color to the mesh where the weight value is applied. ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/44157615801113) 4. Modify the Range and Option values and freely pinch the pattern.
content_description: Explore the new Soft Selection options for the Pinching function in CLO 2025.0 to enhance your simulation experience with detailed settings and customization.

title: Omniverse Connector
content: **New in 2025.0** Add Server Create/Join Session Session in Progress Leave Session Easily exchange USD data via Omniverse Connect to enhance collaborative productivity. For more information on NVIDIA and Omniverse, please check out the links below. * [Create NVIDIA account](https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/omniverse/) * [Download and install the Omniverse Launcher](https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/omniverse/download/) * [Set the Omniverse server](https://docs.omniverse.nvidia.com/prod_nucleus/prod_nucleus/overview.html) #### **Add Server** You can add Omniverse Nucleus server in CLO. 1. Click Settings » Display » Window » Omniverse Connect in the top menu. 2. Click Omniverse icon » Add Sever, and enter the sever address. #### **Create/Join Session** 1. [ Import a USD file](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/29738864727449-USD-File-Import-Export-ver-2024-0#Click1) which from both Omniverse USD Composer and CLO to connect to the session. 2. Open the same file opend in CLO in Omniverse USD Composer » Content Tab. 3. Create a sesstion in Omniverse USD Composer » LIVE Icon → A session is succesfully created, and you are automatically joined that session with the LIVE icon is activated in Omniverse USD Composer. The Live Session Layer is displayed once you are joined the session. 4. Join the session in CLO » Omniverse Connector Window » Omniverse Icon » Join Session. → The layer from the session is added as a Live type in the USD Layer window. The layer will have the same name as the Live Session Layer in Omniverse USD Composer, and be set to the Authoring Layer. #### **Session in Progress** Export files from CLO to Omniverse USD Composer. When a session in Omniverse USD Composer is connected in CLO, you can export your work in CLO to Omniverse USD Composer through the Export to USD Layer feature. The way Omniverse USD Composer updates the work depends on the type of USD layer (USD, LIVE) that the Authoring Layer is set to. 1. Where the Live Session Layer is set as the Authoring Layer, select desired clothing or trims and click on Export to USD Layer from the right mouse button pop-up menu. → The changes of the session layer is directly reflected to the Omniverse USD Composer. _* Where a USD Layer is set as the Authoring Layer, the selected are exported to the USD file, but not directly reflected to the Omniverse USD Composer._ 2. To see these changes in the Omniverse USD Composer, click **FETCH** button when the 'Base USD files have been changed' pop-up appears. ![usd_fetch.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/45594882482841) **📝****Note:** ▪️ If there is no Prim with the same name on the same Prim Path in Omniverse USD Composer, add a new Prim (Append). ▪️ If there is a Prim with the same name in the Prim Path you set for export in Omniverse USD Composer, the changes will be overwritten on that Prim. #### **Leave Session ** You can leave the session that you are in both CLO and Omniverse USD Composer. 1. Click the Omniverse Icon in Omniverse Connector » Leave Session. → The current session ends and the Live mark disappears from the Omniverse icon. The list of session participants disappears. 2. Click the Live Icon in Omniverse USD Composer in CLO » Leave Session. → The current session ends and the Live status is changed to deactivated. The list of session participants disappears. _**✨Tip:** _ Please try out this [USD sample file](https://s3.marvelousdesigner.com/newmdweb/helpcenter/manual/KoiFish_USD.zip) we created with CLO and see how the new USD support can benefit your workflow.
content_description: Discover how to enhance collaborative productivity by seamlessly exchanging USD data through the new features in NVIDIA Omniverse 2025.0, including easy session management and server integration.

title: USD Layer Window
content: ## **New in 2025.0** Create/Open Set Options Export #### With USD, a graphics standard file format, you can increase collaboration productivity with a variety of 3D software. You can export clothing, avatars, and accessories with meshes and materials as USD files. You can also import USD files created in other 3D software packages into CLO. A list of layers for the imported file can be found in the USD Layer window. #### #### **Create/Open** 1. Click Main Menu ▶ Settings ▶ Display ▶ Windows ▶ USD Layer. Or, right-click on the top of the side window, such as Object Browser or Property Editor. Create | Create an USD file \- An USD file is created with the specified path and name, appearing in the USD Layer window. This file will be set as the Authoring Layer. \- When exporting the Material, a Texture folder is created within the directory where the USD is saved. ---|--- Open | Import an USD file Clear | Delete all the layers listed in the USD Layer. 2. The list of created or opend USD layers is structured as follows. Authoring Layer | The default layer which is being used at the moment. \- When running Export to USD Layer for clothing, trims, scenes and props, they will be exported to the Authoring Layer. ---|--- Material | The default path where the Materials appear. \- Users can name this path while running Export to USD Layer. Mesh | The default path where the Mesh appears. \- Users can name this path while running Export to USD Layer. #### #### **Set Options** 1. Right-click on the layer list to set options if needed. ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/44171634932377) Set Authoring Layer | Set the selected layer as active. \- The same can be done by double clicking the left mouse button** **This menu won't appear in the following situations: \- Where the selected layer is already set as the Authoring Layer. \- Where the selected layer is an USDZ (read only) \- Where the selected layer is missing. ---|--- Delete | Deleted the selected layer. This menu won't appear in the following situations: \- Where the selected layer is the Authoring Layer. Export USDZ from Layer | Export the selected layer as USDZ (read only) Once an USDZ is imported, it cannot be exported again. #### #### **Export** To export your cloth and/or trim assets from CLO as a USD file; select the assets from either 3D or 2D window, and click "Export to USD Layer" of the object context menu to export them to the Authoring Layer. This will update the USD file corresponding to the Authoring Layer. 1. Set export options if needed. Prim | Mesh | Prim Path | Either select or deselect Mesh. \- You can name the Prim Path for the Mesh when exporting. ---|---|---|--- Material | Prim Path | Either select or deselect Material. \- You can name the Prim Path for the Material. \- When exporting the Material, a Texture folder is created within the folder where the USD is saved. All related textures will be saved in that Texture folder. Object | Single Object | Exports selected object as a single object. Multiple Objects | Exports selected object as multiple objects. Thin | Export USD without the rendering thickness. Thick | Export USD with the rendering thickness as Geometry. Unified UV Coordinates | Exports the texture data for all patterns to fit within UV coordinates Image Size | Set the size of the image in pixels Fill Texture Seams | Extend the scope of texture based on the texture's borders. Include Garment Simulation Data | USD export for garments, including the necessary data for simulation setup. Include Fur Strand Data | Include the Fur Strand information. Option | Cache Animation | Saves pattern cache animation. **📝****Note:** Since Pattern Cache Animation is exported as a mesh itself, there is no separate Animation Type prim. Avatar Animation | Joint | Saves the animation data for Avatar animation as skeletal animation. Avatar Animation is exported to the USD Layer Window as a SkelAnimation type below SkelRoot. Cache | Saves avatar cache animation. Basic | Scale | Set the unit of scale. % | Adjust the scale in percentage. Axis Conversion | Up Axis | Select the up-axis used in the application where the file was imported from. Marvelous Designer will compare the up-axis of the incoming file and apply conversion if necessary. **📝****Note:** In Marvelous Designer, the Y axis is the up-axis. **📝****Note:** When exporting garment using Export to USD Layer, the exported output will differ depending on the 3D Garment Rendering Style state. If the 3D garment appears in Thick Textured Surface, it will be exported with thickness.
content_description: Discover the powerful new USD export and import features in CLO 2025.0, designed to enhance collaboration and streamline your 3D design workflow.

title: Color Window / How do I change colors in my project?
content: ## **Objective** Edit the color of different components in your scene: Fabrics, graphics, buttons, buttonholes, topstitches, puckering, avatars and avatar accessories, trims, zippers, imported files such as OBJs, etc. ## **Location** For components listed in the Object Browser: [Object Browser](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115000374247-Object-Browser) ▶ Fabric/Graphic/Button/Buttonhole/Topstitch/Puckering/Trim Tab ▶ Item ▶ **Color** **All** components in the scene can be selected via the Scene tab in the Object Browser, however, to access their traits in the Property Editor, it also suffices to select the following in the 3D Window: **Avatars, shoes, hair, earrings, scene & props, zippers, imported components such as e.g. OBJs and FBXs, etc.** In the **Color** row, click on the color chip on the right. ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/42486295176729) ## **Operation** 1. Follow the indicated guideline above: The color window opens. 2. Refer to the table below: ![mceclip1.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/360070124113) ### **Custom Palette** | ① Edit Color | Click the color you want to use from the color field or enter color values. ---|---|--- ② Eyedropper | Select the color you want to use from an image, inside of the program, or anything else visible on your screen. ③ Add Color | Add the selected color into the current Custom Palette. ④ Swatch Size | Adjust the size of swatches. ⑤ Open/Save File | Open or save color palette files. Compatible file formats for import: ACO, ASE, CCO, QTX. Note that you can only save color palettes in both the ACO and CCO file formats. (CCO is CLO-internal.) ⑥ Reset | Reset your current Custom Palette. ⑦ Change the View | Choose List, Detail, or Icon view to change the view. ⑧ Edit Color Swatch | Rename | Double-click the swatch to change the name. Reorder | Click & drag and drop the swatch to change the order. Delete | Click the swatch and remove it by hitting the Delete key on the keyboard. ### **** ### Palette Library | Other than the default palette, the Color Library provides the following color palettes: \- **Coloro** 3500 \- **Pantone** : Color Bridge Coated V5, Color Bridge Coated V5, Color Bridge Uncoated V5, Pastels & Neons Coated, FHI Polyester TSX, CMYK Uncoated, CMYK Coated, Solid Coated-V5, FHI Cotton TCX 2801, Solid Uncoated-V5, Pastels & Neons Uncoated, f+h nylon brights TN, METALLICS Coated \- **YKK** Global Colors ⑨ Add Palette File | Import palette files (ACO, ASE, CCO, QTX). ⑩ Search Color | Search via color name or code. ⑪ Add Color to Custom Palette | Add a color from the Palette Library to the Custom Palette. **※ Note:** Instantly change the color of another object by selecting it while the color window is open (ver 7.1).
content_description: This web page provides a comprehensive guide to editing the colors of various components in your scene, including fabrics, buttons, avatars, and more, using the Object Browser and Property Editor in CLO 3D.

title: Object Browser
content: **View and edit items used in both 3D and 2D windows such as Scene, Fabrics, Graphics, Buttons, Buttonholes, Topstitches, Puckerings, and Trims. Grading and POMs can also be accessed here.** ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/42486747889945) **Scene** | The Scene tab is the most streamlined tool for finding or selecting a component in your scene. It lets you quickly review a list of all items and their structure in the 3D and 2D Windows. The list follows the order of creation. ---|--- **Fabric** | All fabrics used in and added to the scene. Users can select, add, copy and reset a fabric. Click and drag to reorder fabrics as desired (ver 4.1.0). **Graphic** | All graphics used in or added to the scene. Users can select, add, and copy graphics. **Button** | All buttons used in or added to the scene. Users can select, add, and copy Button. **Buttonhole** | All buttonholes used in or added to the scene. Users can select, add, and copy buttonholes. **Topstitch** | All topstitches used in or added to the scene. Users can select, add, and copy topstitches. **Puckering** | All puckerings used in or added to the scene. Users can select, add, and copy puckerings. **Trim** | All trims added to the scene. Users can select, add, and copy trims. **Grading** | Assign, add, and edit the grade rules of the garments present in the scene. **POM** | All POMs added to the scene. Users can delete and rename POMs.
content_description: This web page allows users to efficiently view, edit, and manage components in both 3D and 2D environments, including fabrics, graphics, buttons, and grading options.

title: Set Graphic Options
content: Set CLO's Graphic Options.![Youtube Icon.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/45588842971289)[Watch Video](https://youtu.be/laMem5VP5ro) 1. Click Setting ▶ User Settings ▶ **Graphic Options** in the top menu. **Option** | **Description** ---|--- **Antialiasing** | Set how smooth the outlines of objects appear. As the number increases, the outlines become smoother and the rendering speed becomes slower **Use VBOs** | Set the VBOs usage in order to improve the rendering speed. **** **Normal Blending ** | Choose how to blend the normal map. The normal map blending result is reflected in the 3D window and [UV Editor](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/360053418574-UV-Editor-Mode-ver-6-0-). **Alpha Blending** A method that simulates the normal blending effect using the alpha value. **Partial Derivative** A method of blending the height map using partial derivatives of the normal map. **Whiteout** A technique optimized to reduce the amount of computation and it is a way to preserve detail while maintaining the tendency of a relatively flat normal. **UDN** Compared to Whiteout and Reoriented, the detail of the normal map is slightly reduced but the optimized calculation method is useful for low-end platforms. **Reoriented** A method that preserves the intensity of all mixed normal maps while maintaining the trend of the flat normal map and the details of the complex normal map well. This is the most accurate and slow method by rotating the normal of the detail to match the normal of the base. **Unity** It is the same method as reoriented but the error in certain situations (when two mixed normals are orthogonal) is abandoned and the performance is improved. **Image Resolution Setting** | ![Update.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/45588844260889) Set the maximum image resolution for the rendering. The Image that exceed the set resolution is downscaled only while rendering to optimize performance. The higher the image resolution, the more memory CLO requires to render and process.
content_description: Explore how to customize your CLO software's graphic settings to enhance rendering performance and visual quality through detailed options and adjustments.

title: Add Point or Curve Point to Line (Avatar)
content: ### **Objective** Use the right-click pop-up menu to add point or curve point to modify Lines (Avatar). **Location ** Main Menu ▶ 3D Garment ▶ **Edit 3D Pen (Avatar)** 3D Toolbar ▶ ![Edit_Line.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/360000520707/Edit_Line.png) **Edit 3D Pen (Avatar)** ** Operation** 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu ▶ 3D Garment ▶ **Edit 3D Pen****(Avatar)** 3D Toolbar ▶ ![Edit_Line.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/360000520707/Edit_Line.png) **EEdit 3D Pen (Avatar)** → When the Avatar is draped in a Garment, the Garment becomes translucent. 2. Right click on the Line (Avatar) where a point or curve point should be added. → The right-click pop-up menu appears. 3. Choose **Add Point** or **Add Curve Point** as needed. → **Add Point** : a segment point is added to the selected line. → **Add Curve Point** : a curve point is added to the selected line. 4. Select and move the added point or curve point by using the **![Edit_Line.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/360000520707/Edit_Line.png)Edit 3D Pen (Avatar)** tool to edit 3D Pen (Avatar).
content_description: This web page provides a step-by-step guide for using the right-click pop-up menu in the 3D Garment editor to add and modify points on lines associated with avatars.

title: Set Avatar Options
content: Set the Avatar via the right-click pop-up menu.** ** 1. Click ![Select On.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/45502133023641)**Select/Move** tool in the 3D toolbar. 2. Right-click on the avatar and set the options as needed. **Option** | **Descriptions** ---|--- **Select All Faces** | Select all surfaces of an Avatar. **Move Avatar &Garment ** | Select and Move both avatar and garment. **Delete Avatar** | Select an avatar and delete it. **Move Avatar/ Move All Avatars & Garments ** | Move Avatar or all Avatars and garments to the center of the 3D window or the ground. **Flip Pose** | ![Update.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/45502133027993)[![Youtube Icon \(1\).png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/48855621738393)](https://youtu.be/iwBPXsOrI9o?si=lhuXO8iOaprQawbP) Easily flip the avatar pose to the desired direction. The garment on the avatar also transitions when flipping poses. **Reset Joints** | Reset joints of the Avatars. **Change Heels** | Make Avatars' heels up or down. **Deactivate/Activate Avatar** | Deactivate or activate avatars as needed. When it is deactivated, the garments do not recognize while simulation. **Deactivate/ Hide ** | Deactivate and Hide the selected part of the Avatar at the same time. **Show/Hide All Avatars** | Show or hide individual or all avatars.
content_description: This web page provides a comprehensive guide on how to set and manage avatars using the right-click pop-up menu in the 3D tool, detailing various options available for selection, movement, and customization.

title: Stress Map
content: \- The **Stress Map** shows any stress applied onto garments; check the force along the fabric grain per unit area on garments. \- Hover over the third icon in the Vertical Toggle Menu in the 3D window. Then, Select the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115001846908/CLT_Group_06Strain_Normal.png)**Stress Map** icon. \- Any part not under stress will appear in blue, but under stress, that part of the garment will turn closer to red. \- There is a common misconception that Stress is Pressure. For evaluating external pressure being applied to the avatar, please use the [Pressure Map](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/360000436368-Garment-Fit-Maps) instead.
content_description: The Stress Map visualizes stress distribution on garments, allowing users to identify areas of tension through a color-coded system, with blue indicating no stress and red indicating high stress.

title: Topstitch Item/Property
content: **List of Contents** Topstitch Item Topstitch Item List Editing Topstitch Item Utilizing Topstitch Item **Topstitch Item ** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=siDrzKHsQYE \- Create and edit Topstitch items. \- Navigate to Object Browser – **Topstitch** Tab ******Topstitch Item List** \- Default_Topstitch is part of the program asset which is created upon download. It is fixed in the list and cannot be deleted. * **Adding Topstitch Item YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GsN1Gzuc568 ** \- Navigate to Object Browser ▶ Topstitch Tab ▶ **Add** Button \- A new Topstitch item is created. * **Duplicating Topstitch Item YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9ZIY93haZnc **\- Click on the Topstitch item to be duplicated. \- The **Copy** button above the Topstitch List is activated. \- Click the Copy button as a duplicated Topstitch will be created at the bottom of the list. * **Deleting Topstitch Item YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Egq5lKl3d9U ** \- Only unused Topstitch item can be deleted. \- Click on the **Delete** icon located at the right side of the Topstitch item. \- Or right-click on the Topstitch item to access the pop-up menu. Select **Delete.** **Editing Topstitch Item** \- Select the Topstitch item to be edited and navigate to Object Browser. * **Name YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xwLXzzKZOmM ** \- Change name for the selected Topstitch item. * **Type YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gQnINA0EvTc ** \- There are two types of Topstitches: **OBJ** and **Texture**. ** -** Select desired option. * **Material YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RuPI4QrEPjU ** * **Preset** \- Select shapes of Topstitches among provided options: **Custom** , **Bartack** , **Buttonhole** , **Overlock** ,**Pickstitch** , **Single** , **Single_Offset_0** , **Zigzag**. \- When either Buttonhole or Overlock is selected, an additional option **Stitch Width** will appear. * **Color** \- Click on the color chip to change Topstitch color. \- Click on the drop-down arrow next to **Color** to access child options: **Ambient Intensity** and **Diffuse Intensity.** \- Adjust each option as needed. * **Offset** \- Commonly used offset values are provided as preset. \- Input specified value as needed. \- The unit corresponds to the unit that is currently used in CLO. * **Length(SPI)** \- Adjust the length of each Stitch. \- **SPI** is the abbreviation for Stitch per Inch. As SPI increases, each Stitch length shortens. \- Input specified stitch length as needed. * **Thread Thickness** \- Adjust the Thickness of the Thread manually. \- Expand the drop down menus by clicking the Arrow button. \- Choose the desired unit used for Thread Thickness among Tex, Ticket (Tkt,) Metric (Nm,) Denier (Den,) and Millimeter. \- When Preset is set as **Pickstitch** , a child option is added to adjust distance in between each Stitch. * **Face** \- Choose the Topstitch’s placement on the fabric: **Front** , **Back** , **Both** * **Number of Line** \- Assign number of lines for a Topstitch item. \- When more than two lines are created, a child option **Distance** will appear. Use this option to adjust the apart distance of lines. \- Select among provided values or input custom values as needed. * **Multilayered Topstitch YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=W-ZdopXkaAY ** \- When a Topstitch item is created, only one layer is created by default. \- To create multilayered Topstitch, click the + tab next to 1 tab. \- Toggle On **Use This Stitch** option. The options will be activated. \- Adjust options as needed. \- As many as five layers of Stitches can be created to express complicated Stitch styles such as Color Overlock. * **Multilayered Topstitch_ver.4.1.0 and Above YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qciKwUC2WNw ** \- Create various different types of Topstitches up to five at a time. \- Choose the desired number of Topstitch lines using the drop down menu next to Stitch Count. \- To configure multiple lines of a single Topstitch style at the same time, toggle on below options as needed. \- **Use Same Specification** : Toggle on this option to configure multiple topstitches' Specification related options such as Shape, Length, Space and more at the same time. \- **Use Material** : Toggle on this option to configure multiple topstitches' Material related options such as Texture, Color, Type and more at the same time. * **Default Topstitch Tread Thickness Unit_ver.4.2.0 and avobe YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=S-E1LfsdUtA ** \- Change the default unit for Topstitch thickness. \- Navigate to Main Menu ▶ Settings ▶ User Settings ▶ User Interface ▶ Default Topstitch Thread Thickness Unit \- Select the desired unit among five options. * **Space_ver.4.2.0 and avobe YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PpIYHX8U0_Q ** \- Set the distance between each stitch of Topstitch style. \- The Space value can be both negative and positive values. **Utilizing Topstitch Item ** * **Saving/Opening Topstitch Item YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=keaitLUSI8M ** \- Select the Topstitch item to be saved. \- Click on the **Save** button at the top of the properties. \- A file browser will appear. Designate file name and path, and then click on the **Save** button. \- The Topstitch item will be saved as .sst format. \- To open a Topstitch item, select the **Open** button at the top of the properties. \- When a file browser appears, located and open the Topstitch item to be opened. * **Applying Topstitch Item YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WAdBP9OrjtY ** \- Select the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115024511568/mceclip0.png) **Edit Topstitch** tool from the 2D toolbar. \- Then, navigate to 2D window and select on the Topstitch line created on 2D Pattern. The selected Topstitch line will be highlighted in pink. \- Click **Assign** button. \- The selected Topstitch item will be applied to the Topstitch line created on 2D Pattern. \- Or right-click on the Topstitch line on 2D Pattern to access a pop-up menu. \- Select **Assign** to New Topstitch. \- A new Topstitch item is created as it is automatically assigned to the selected Topstitch line on 2D Pattern. ([Reference Editing Topstitch](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115013749468)) Go back to the List of Contents
content_description: This web page serves as a comprehensive guide for creating, editing, managing, and utilizing Topstitch items, featuring instructional videos and detailed steps for each process.

title: Fabric
content: **List of Contents** Fabric Add Fabric Item Copy Fabric Item Assign Fabric Item Reset Fabric Item Delete Fabric Item **Fabric ** \- In CLO, Fabric can be created just like how it is created in real life, applying texture to material properties. ** Add Fabric Item** **YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Kzq-xA0dlU4 ** * **The Add Button** \- Click the Add button on the Object Browser’s Fabric Tab. \- A new Fabric Item will be added to the Object Browser. * **Drag & Drop** \- Drag and Drop the Fabric file from the Desktop to the Object Browser. \- The selected file will be added to the Fabric list as a Fabric Item. * **Add From the Library Window** \- When there is a Fabric file in the Library Window, double-click the Fabric file to open. \- The dialogue will appear to inform the user that the file has been added to the Object Browser. The selected file will be added to the Object Browser as a Fabric Item. **Copy Fabric Item** **YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=au3lb4_IB-g** \- Select the Fabric Item to be duplicated from the Object Browser. \- Click the Copy button on the right side of the Fabric Item. \- A new Fabric Item will be added having the same material properties with the selected Fabric Item. **Assign Fabric Item** **YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZRZwQfiLpho** \- Select the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115022307188/mceclip0.png) **Transform Pattern** tool or the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115021992087/mceclip0.png) **Edit Pattern** tool from the 2D toolbar. \- Navigate to the 2D window and select the Pattern that a new Fabric Item will be applied to. \- Locate and click the Assign button on the right top of the Object Browser. \- A new Fabric Item will be added to the Object Browser and it will be automatically applied to the selected Pattern. **Reset Fabric Item** **YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mCtXrpTFhTA** \- Right-click on a Fabric Item which its settings will be reset and select **Reset.** \- All settings such as texture, color, and material properties will be changed to default values. **Delete Fabric Item** **YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=h4rv0BgtRgk** \- A Fabric Item can be deleted and the Delete icon will appear only when it is not applied to any Pattern. If the fabric Item is applied to any Pattern, it cannot be deleted and the Delete icon will disappear. \- When the Delete icon does not appear next to the Fabric Item to be deleted, resolve the issue by following the steps below: \- Select the Fabric Item to be deleted from the Object Browser. The Patterns applied with the selected Fabric Item will be highlighted in pink. \- Navigate to the 2D window and right click on any Pattern highlighted in pink. Then, click Select All with Same Property ▶ **Fabric** \- Apply other Fabric Items to the selected Patterns. * **Delete Icon ** \- Select the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115022307728/mceclip1.png) **Delete** icon next to the Fabric Item. \- The selected Fabric Item will be deleted from the Object Browser. * **Delete Option from the Right Click Pop-up Menu ** \- Right-click on the Fabric Item to be deleted and select **Delete** from the pop-up window. \- The selected Fabric Item will be deleted from the Object Browser. ** ** * **Delete key on Keyboard ** \- Click the Fabric Item to be deleted and hit the **Delete** key on the keyboard. \- The selected Fabric Item will be deleted from the Object Browser. Go back to the List of Contents
content_description: This webpage serves as a comprehensive guide for managing fabric items in CLO, including adding, copying, assigning, resetting, and deleting fabric items, along with instructional videos for each process.

title: Segment Topstitch
content: **Segment TopstitchYouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XYMtMb_W7I8** **-** Establish the Topstitch along the Segments of the Pattern outlines and the Internal Shapes/ Lines. \- Select the ![Toolbar_Common_Stitch_Normal.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/360001029448/Toolbar_Common_Stitch_Normal.png)**Segment Topstitch** tool from the 2D toolbar. \- Or, navigate to the Main Menu and select Material ▶ **Segment Topstitch**. \- Hover over the desired Segment of the Pattern outlines or the Internal Lines. \- Click and on the Segment. \- The Segment Topstitch created on the Pattern outlines or the Internal Lines should be highlighted in pink.
content_description: Learn how to effectively use the Segment Topstitch tool in your pattern design by following our step-by-step guide to enhance your sewing projects.

title: Paste
content: **List of Contents** Paste Paste with Specific Values **Paste** \- Paste copied Patterns and Internal Shapes. * **Paste a Pattern ** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9AYlKFvBdfc \- Navigate to the 2D toolbar and select the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115021447968/mceclip0.png) **Transform Pattern** tool or the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115021447988/mceclip1.png) **Edit Pattern** tool. \- Right-click on the Pattern to be duplicated and select **Copy.** \- The selected Pattern will be duplicated. \- Right-click on the 2D window and select **Paste** from the pop-up menu. \- The duplicated Pattern will follow along with the mouse cursor. \- Click on the 2D window to Paste the Pattern. \- The identical Pattern will be created in the 2D window. -※ Note: Trims are copied and pasted along with Patterns (ver5.0.0.) * **Paste an Internal Shape** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TplJM7z79bY \- Navigate to the 2D toolbar and select the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115021447968/mceclip0.png) **Transform Pattern** tool or the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115021447988/mceclip1.png) **Edit Pattern** tool. \- Right click on the Internal Shape to be duplicated and select **Copy.** \- The selected Internal Shape will be duplicated. \- Right click on the 2D window and select **Paste** from the pop-up menu. \- The duplicated Internal Shape will follow along the mouse cursor. \- Click within the Pattern to Paste the Internal Shape. \- The identical Internal Shape will be created in the 2D window. ** Paste with Specific Values** * **Paste a Pattern** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sLohWrXuAZE \- Navigate to the 2D toolbar and select the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115021447968/mceclip0.png) **Transform Pattern** tool or the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115021447988/mceclip1.png) **Edit Pattern** tool. \- Right click on the Pattern to be duplicated and select **Copy.** \- The selected Pattern will be duplicated. \- Right click on the 2D window and select **Paste** from the pop-up menu. \- The duplicated Pattern will follow along the mouse cursor. \- Right click on the 2D window to access the **Paste** pop-up window. \- Enter the desired values to Interval and Number Of Shapes. Then, click OK. \- The Pattern will be pasted based on the settings. * **Paste an Internal Shapes ** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZmpPxOhezg0 \- Navigate to the 2D toolbar and select the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115021447968/mceclip0.png) **Transform Pattern** tool or the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115021447988/mceclip1.png) **Edit Pattern** tool. \- Right click on the Internal Shape to be duplicated and select **Copy.** \- The selected Internal Shape will be duplicated. \- Right click on the 2D window and select **Paste** from the pop-up menu. \- The duplicated Internal Shape will follow along the mouse cursor. \- Right click on the 2D window to access the **Paste** pop-up window. \- Enter the desired values to Internval, Number OF Shapes, and Position. Then, click OK. \- The Internal Shape will be pasted based on the settings. Go back to the List of Contents
content_description: This webpage provides step-by-step instructions and video tutorials for effectively pasting patterns and internal shapes in a 2D design environment, including options for specific values.

title: Particle Distance
content: **List of Contents** Particle Distance Adjust Particle Distance **Particle Distance** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_u4mt-Yg3ew \- Adjust Particle Distance to manage the Garment quality and Simulation speed. \- Navigate to Property Editor ▶ Simulation Properties ▶ **Particle Distance** ** Adjust Particle Distance** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=goDk-yEFzfM \- Using the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115022678287/mceclip0.png) **Transform pattern** tool, select the Pattern to be edited. \- Navigate to the Property Editor ▶ Simulation Properties ▶ **Particle Distance.** \- The default value of the **Particle Distance** is 20. Lower this value to 5 and simulate. \- The quality of the 3D Garment increases as the size of the Particle Distance decreases. Go back to the List of Contents
content_description: This web page provides a comprehensive guide on adjusting Particle Distance to enhance garment quality and simulation speed in 3D modeling.

title: 3D Snapshot
content: **List of Contents** Single View Multi View Save 3D window snapshots from one or more angles as images. 1. Click the Main Menu ▶ File ▶ Snapshot ▶ **3D Window (F10)** 2. Enter desired file name and location, then click **Save**. 3. Set details as needed: #### **Single View** **Option** | **Description** ---|--- **Image** **Size** | **Preset** | Customize or select from provided preset options. **Orientation** | Select from portrait or landscape orientation options. **Width** | Set the width of the image. **Height** | Set the height of the image. **Unit** | Sets the unit of measurement for the image. **Resolution** | Sets the pixels per inch for the image. From ver3.2.0, the image resolution (ppi) will automatically adjust depending on the selected paper size for optimal printing results. **Colorway**** ** | ![Update.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/44189528036633) Set whether to save only the current colorway or all colorways. Or, choose specific colorways by clicking the ![Select Colorway.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/44191274180633) **Select Colorways** button. **Option** | **Transparent Background** | Save the image with a transparent background. **Save HTML File ** | A HTML file of the snapshot is also saved. **Reset** | Resets the options back to the program default settings. #### **Multiview** **Option** | **Description** ---|--- **Preview** | **Preset** | Mouse-over on the preview image ▶ Select desired view option from drop-down menu. **Custom** | Customize view angle in the 3D window. Mouse-over on the preview image ▶ Click on the camera icon. **Layout** | **View Count** | Select the number of views to capture. Set it up to 10 views. (ver 5.2) **Layout** | Select from horizontal/vertical/box layout options. **Single ****Image ****Size** | **Preset** | Customize or select from preset image size. **Orientation** | Select from portrait or landscape orientation options. **Width** | Set the width of the image. **Height** | Set the height of the image. **Unit** | Sets the unit of measurement for the image. **Resolution** | Sets the pixels per inch for the image. From ver3.2.0, the image resolution (ppi) will automatically adjust depending on the selected paper size for optimal printing results. **Colorway** | ![Update.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/44189528036633) Set whether to save only the current colorway or all colorways. Or, choose specific colorways by clicking the ![Select Colorway.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/44191274180633) **Select Colorways** button. **Option** | **Transparent Background** | Save the image with a transparent background. **Save Separate Images** | Save the multi-view in individual images. **Save HTML File ** | A HTML file of the snapshot is also saved. **Open** | Open all the setting options in *.mvs file format. **Save** | Save all the setting options in *.mvs file format. **Reset** | Resets the options back to the program default settings. Go back to the List of Contents
content_description: This web page serves as a comprehensive guide for capturing and saving 3D window snapshots in both single and multi-view formats, detailing customizable options for image size, orientation, resolution, and colorways.

title: Smart Arrangement
content: **Smart Arrangement** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wysSD11q5Qc \- Arrange the Patterns near their sewn pairs maintaining their drape. \- Choose the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115021552387/mceclip0.png) **Select/Move** tool from the 3D toolbar and navigate to the 3D window. \- Right-click on the 3D Garment and select **Smart Arrangement.** \- The selected Pattern will be arranged next to the sewn pair without distortion of the drape.
content_description: This web page provides a concise guide on using the Smart Arrangement feature in Clo3D to efficiently organize patterns alongside their sewn pairs while preserving their drape.

title: Flip Horizontally (3D)
content: **Flip Horizontally** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Cx7f8Ri-hQs \- Flip the selected Pattern horizontally. \- Choose the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115021552387/mceclip0.png) **Select/Move** tool from the 3D toolbar and navigate to the 3D window. \- Right-click on the 3D Garment and select **Flip Horizontally.** \- The selected Pattern will flip horizontally, maintaining its drape
content_description: Learn how to effortlessly flip your selected pattern horizontally in Clo3D using the Select/Move tool, ensuring a perfect drape for your garment.

title: Garment File Save/Open
content: **List of Contents** Garment File Open Garment File Save Garment File **Garment File** \- The Garment file is composed with followings: 3D Garments, 2D Patterns, Colorways, Print Layout, and comments. Save above information along with 3D Garments as a .zpac file and re-open to edit. ** Open Garment File** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jB27g_SM2I4 \- Navigate to the Main Menu and select File ▶ Open ▶ **Garment.** \- Locate the garment file and select **Open.** The selected garment file will load. **Save Garment File** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XE8fUfTfDzk \- Navigate to the Main Menu and select File ▶ Save As ▶ **Garment.** \- Assign the saving path and the file name, then click **Save.** Go back to the List of Contents
content_description: This web page provides step-by-step instructions and video tutorials for opening and saving garment files, including details on managing 3D garments, 2D patterns, and related information.

title: Show UV Guide
content: **Show UV Guide** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LFVafDNnxyI \- Check the UV area before exporting the 3D Garment. \- Select the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115022677527/mceclip0.png) **Show** **UV Guide** tool from the 2D toolbar. \- Or, navigate to and select Main Menu ▶ Display ▶ 2D Pattern ▶ **Show** **UV Guide. ** \- When the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115022677527/mceclip0.png) **Show UV Guide** tool is activated, the marquee box showing the UV area will appear.
content_description: This webpage provides a concise guide on how to use the "Show UV Guide" tool for checking UV areas before exporting 3D garments, complemented by an instructional YouTube video.

title: Show/Hide Avatar
content: **List of Contents** Avatar Display Icons Show Avatar Show Arrangement Point Show Bounding Volumes Show Avatar Measurements Show Avatar Tape Show 3D Lines **Avatar Display Icons** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XJUAbo31JBo \- Show or hide icons related to Avatars. \- Navigate to the 3D window and hover over the second icon in the Vertical View Toggle Menu. ** ****Show Avatar** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=G5GPqukCjbY \- Click the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115022729208/mceclip6.png) **Show Avatar** icon to show or hide avatars from the 3D window. **Show Arrangement Point** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PsQrarfO6NU \- Click the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115022667947/mceclip11.png) **Show Arrangement****Point** icon to show or hide arrangement points on Avatar. **Show Bounding Volumes** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dsQryIqd_3Q \- Click the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115022729828/mceclip8.png) **Show Bounding Volumes** icon to show or hide bounding volumes on Avatar. **Show Avatar Measurements** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dQWTd_EYHzM \- Click the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115022729868/mceclip9.png) **Show Avatar Measurements** icon to show or hide measurements on Avatars.。 **Show Avatar Tape** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vUcr-hzgCyk \- Click the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115022668107/mceclip12.png) **Show Avatar Tape** icon to show or hide Avatar Tapes on Avatars. **Show 3D Lines** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YechGNCPsbg \- Click the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115022668127/mceclip14.png) **Show 3D Lines** icon to show or hide 3D lines drawn on Avatar. Go back to the List of Contents
content_description: This web page serves as a comprehensive guide to managing and displaying avatar-related features in a 3D environment, complete with instructional videos for each function.

title: Solidify
content: **List of Contents** Solidify Result of Solidify **Solidify** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jW7YiDEbfhU \- Fix the drape of the Pattern and maintain the shape while simulating. \- Use the Solidify function when creating a hat’s cap and a bra’s cup where Pattern shapes need to be fixed. \- Select the Patterns using the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115022683507/mceclip0.png) **Transform Pattern** tool, right click, and select the **Solidify** option from the pop-up menu. \- Or, select the Patterns using the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115022683507/mceclip0.png) **Transform Pattern** tool, navigate to the Property Editor and toggle on **Solidify** **Result of Solidify** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zkhlay2bIP8 \- The selected Pattern will maintain its drape. \- Set how strong Pattern will maintain its drape by adjusting the **Strengthen** option. \- The Selected Pattern will maintain its drape depending on the Strengthen setting when the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115022683567/mceclip1.png)**Simulation** is activated. content_description: This webpage provides a comprehensive guide on using the Solidify function in CLO 3D to enhance the drape and shape of patterns in garment design, featuring instructional videos and step-by-step instructions.

title: Emission Color
content: **Emission Color** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vtzyXCd0tLE \- Adjust the **Emission Color** to express retro-reflection and luminous materials which emit light by itself. \- Select the fabric item in the Object Browser to apply the Emission Color. \- Navigate to the Property Editor and select the color chip next to Material ▶ **Emission Color.** \- The Color window will appear allowing you to select the Emission Color. \- Click or type in desired values to RGB to apply the desired Emission Color to the fabric.
content_description: Discover how to enhance fabric items with vibrant Emission Colors that create stunning retro-reflections and luminous effects in your designs.

title: Reverse Arrange - Vertically
content: **Reverse Arrange - Vertically** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=F743wtOp1Ac \- Reverse the Patterns vertically maintaining the curvature of the Patterns created when arranging them using the Arrangement Points. \- Choose the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115021552387/mceclip0.png) **Select/Move** tool from the 3D toolbar and navigate to the 3D window. \- Right-click on the 3D Garment and select Reverse Arrange ▶ **Vertically.** \- The selected Pattern will flip vertically maintaining the curvature created when arranged via Arrangement Points.
content_description: This web page provides a concise guide on how to reverse the arrangement of patterns vertically in Clo3D while preserving their curvature using the Select/Move tool.

title: Quadrangular/Triangular Mesh
content: **Convert synchronized 3D Garments into quadrangular or triangular mesh structures.** **![29. Quad Mesh Improvement.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/39597030520857)** **📝****Note:** Please refer below explanation on different usages of Quadrangular Mesh versus Triangular Mesh. As the program speed may differ due to the difference in their intrinsic characteristics, please select most appropriate Mesh Type based on your needs. To use our program most efficiently, however, we **strongly suggest** you to set all Pattern Mesh to Triangular when editing 3D Garments, and then change ONLY necessary Patterns' Mesh type to Quadrangular to complete the Garment. * **When to Use Triangular Mesh** : **All Cases,****** except for special cases needed to use Quadrangular Mesh. * **When to Use Quadrangular Mesh** : When a detail of 3D Garment needs to round smoothly such as shirts collar or piping. #### 1. Click the pattern in 2D or 3D window. 2. Change the Mesh Type to the Quad (Otimized) in the Property Editor.
content_description: This web page provides guidance on converting synchronized 3D garments into quadrangular or triangular mesh structures, helping users optimize their design workflow based on specific garment details.
